page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred. Heading in large spaced capitals at top; dedication lines in roman and italic below; then a Greek verse block with an initial A; signature line; ornament at foot. No margin notes. No page number, no running head.

main_text.head: CONSULTISS. REVER. AMPLISS. eruditione, & longo rerum usu praestantissimis viris:
main_text.p: Dn. Joh. Pistorio, illustris Principis ac DD. Georgii, Hassiae Landgravii &c. Cancellario prudentissimo; ἀναδόχῳ suo perpetuâ observantiâ colendo.
Dn. M. Joh. Angelo, verbi divini apud Darmstatinos interpreti orthodoxo, & sup. Cattimelibocatus Superatt. vigilantis.
Dn. Christophoro Stockheim/avúculo suo plurimùm honorâdo.
Dn. Justo Petro Friederich/ Quaestori apud Bobenhusanos gravissimo, consobrino suo percaro.
Ν̄δρες ἡύςυλοι, σύ θ' ὅτεώ γε κλιτόν Τοῦνομ' εἰςιλὼν ἐςατὴ ἔδωκεν, Τοῦ Διέςυς πλήσει μελέτας ἀεύεςαν Ἡχέτα τέτλιξ.
Λήιον δ' ἤδη φερέμεν κ' ἐγῷδα Ἐρχάτην μύεμηκα, λέγω. τελώςης Ἐρξάπν δὲν μέλιλ⊙ μέλιστὰν Τάνδτεκ γαίης.
Ἀλλ' ἂν ἔλθῃσι χρυσροῖο ὤρη Χείμα⊙, κ' οὔσης σκιερῆς ὀπωρης, Ἀλέγης τέτλιξ ἄπορεῖ ἐδωδῆς Τοῖσδε φάγοντι.
Ἐπομαι απουδὴ ὃ ἐγὼν μελίτης. Ἄνδρες, ὡς καρπῶν λαβέειν, ἀξεσοι, Ἱερῶτα μοισάων χρεὸς ιερέων Λίσετ' ὑμμας.

page.notes: Greek verses are printed with a large initial A and many abbreviations and accents; the Greek transcription is approximate where letters were hard to resolve. Ornament (fleuron) at foot not transcribed. Library stamp "B S B München" and shelf mark "VW 90/96" omitted. Printed names "Stockheim" and "Friederich" appear in a larger, heavier face and may be overprinted.
